pages.title: Your Origin
pages.text: Pick a power set from the list that follows and lock it in at the Origins screen ($(k:origins.view_origin) shows yours any time).$(br2)$(item)No origin blocks any food type$(): dietary traits are only preferences.$(br2)$(item)Environmental effects cause discomfort$(), never death.$(br2)$(item)Phantoms never truly die$(): they enter Spectral Collapse.

pages.title: Origins (1/3)
pages.text: $(bold)Arachnid$(): climbs walls and spins webs. Prefers meat.$(br2)$(bold)Avian$(): Sky Affinity grants speed and agility at high altitudes. Prefers plants.$(br2)$(bold)Blazeborn$(): immune to fire and lava, and Nether Affinity boosts your damage. Water slows you.

pages.title: Origins (1/3), cont.
pages.text: $(bold)Enderian$(): teleports on a cooldown. Ender Shift gives +15% damage for 10s after each teleport. Water drains your strength.$(br2)$(bold)Elytrian$(): Elytra flight and a launch ability. It is the only origin with true flight.

pages.title: Origins (2/3)
pages.text: $(bold)Feline$(): silent, always lands on its feet, night vision. -20% HP.$(br2)$(bold)Merling$(): breathes underwater; sluggish after 5 min ashore.$(br2)$(bold)Phantom$(): phases through blocks; half health. $(warn)Never truly dies$(): it enters Spectral Collapse (a 5 min debuff).$(br2)$(bold)Shulk$(): natural armor, equipment death protection and +20% mining speed. Heavy metabolism.

pages.title: Origins (3/3)
pages.text: $(bold)Witch of Ink$(): a passive hyperscaler with -20% HP, half food and a fire weakness. Boss kills raise your TOTAL damage (melee and magic), and 200 kills unlock Blessing of Penthesilea. $(thing)/icraft witch_status$()$(br2)$(bold)Artificial Construct$(): an iron golem. Eat iron for food and Regen III, and climb a 5-level forge ladder to the Iron Apotheosis capstone. $(thing)/icraft construct_status$()

pages.title: Origins (3/3), cont.
pages.text: $(bold)Witherborn$(): undead DOT melee. Your hits apply Wither, with a hunger-based damage tradeoff.$(br2)$(bold)Slimebodied$(): a food-management tank. Bonus food efficiency, and satiety grants damage reduction.

pages.title: Witch of Ink Tracker
pages.text: $(bold)Counter$() (max 200):$(br)  $(item)Apotheosis/Champions boss$(): +1$(br)  $(item)Dimensional boss$(): +10 (Wither, Dragon, Naga, Lich, etc.)$(br2)$(bold)Per point:$()$(br)  +0.1% TOTAL damage dealt (cap +20%)$(br)  -0.1% incoming damage (cap -20%)$(br2)$(thing)/icraft witch_status$() shows your live counter, current bonuses and capstone payout.

pages.title: Penthesilea Capstone
pages.text: $(bold)Blessing of Penthesilea$() activates permanently at 200:$(br2)$(item)+10%$() additive total damage (1.20 ladder + 0.10 = $(bold)1.30x$())$(br)$(item)+15%$() Spell Power to Attack Damage conversion$(br)$(item)+15%$() max HP$(br)$(item)Permanent:$() Haste I, Resistance I, Fire Resistance, Regeneration I$(br2)The damage buffs $(bold)multiply FINAL damage$(): melee, ranged and all magic (ISS and Ars).

pages.title: Construct Tracker
pages.text: $(bold)Iron-consumed ladder$() (right-click iron ingots or blocks to eat):$(br)  L1: 1000 iron, +5%$(br)  L2: 2000, +10% total$(br)  L3: 4000, +15% total$(br)  L4: 8000, +25% total$(br)  L5: 16000, $(bold)+35% total$()$(br2)Each level: MULTIPLY_BASE on HP and melee, ADD_VALUE × 4 on armor and toughness.$(br2)$(thing)/icraft construct_status$() shows your live state.

pages.title: Iron Apotheosis
pages.text: Reaching L5 unlocks $(bold)Iron Apotheosis$() permanently:$(br2)$(item)+25%$() max HP (+60% total with L5)$(br)$(item)+25%$() melee damage (+60% total)$(br)$(item)+1.0$() armor toughness (with L5's +1.4, +2.4 total)$(br2)Eating iron still gives Regen III for 10s, whatever your level.

pages.title: Design Notes
pages.text: $(bold)Origins are flavor.$() They give unique abilities, your $(thing)Race$() stat modifiers, your $(thing)Class$() a combat role. All three stack.$(br2)$(bold)No combination is unplayable$(), though some are stronger than others.$(br2)$(bold)Hyperscaling origins$() (Witch of Ink, Artificial Construct) are weak early on purpose and reward 50 to 100+ hours.$(br2)$(bold)Next: your Race, which $(italic)is$() permanent: $(l:icraft:classes/race_overview)The Race System$(/l).$()
